# Blocklist overview

The user blocklist service restricts direct channel messaging between users, enabling a "block user" feature for direct conversations.

By default, the blocklist service is enabled for all users under your App Key. The following APIs are available:

* [Add users to blocklist](/platform-chat-api/user/blacklist/add-to-blacklist.md)
* [Remove users from blocklist](/platform-chat-api/user/blacklist/remove-from-blacklist.md)
* [Query blocklist](/platform-chat-api/user/blacklist/query-blacklist.md)

Key points:

* The blocklist limit cannot be adjusted.
* Maintain a copy of the blocklist data on your app server for business data processing.
